warning.titlePre: Mercedes Vario 818D Timing Chain & Injector Seal Wear
paragraphs: Vario 818D engines — OM612 and OM647, across the entire W670 production run — commonly show timing chain and injector seal wear over time. This is a well-documented pattern shared with the equivalent-era Sprinter, and we replace timing chain components, timing gears, injector seals and gaskets as standard on every rebuild.
include_in_hero_hook: yes — Source: established specialist pattern (per G-BRF), confirmed across the whole Vario range via shared Sprinter-era pattern. Applies to both OM612 and OM647.
